name: @latheon/sdk
description: JavaScript SDK for Latheon's V8 and V7 shielded pools and distribution routers: notes and master keys, 20-level Merkle paths, withdraw_v6 and withdraw_v5 proofs, deposits, withdraw and withdrawMany (recipient, relayer, fee and, in V8, payment reference and chain bound into the proof), disclose_v2 and disclose_link proofs.

scripts.test: node test/unit.js && node test/proof.js && node test/report.js
scripts.test:all: node test/unit.js && node test/proof.js && node test/report.js && node test/e2e.js && node test/e2e-v8.js
